what_to_detect: A resolution in which day_night_changed to night is followed by face_change events turning daybound permanents to their back faces.
near_miss: A resolution with no day_night_changed event.

what_to_detect: A daybound or nightbound permanent entering the battlefield with a face_change event to the back face while it is night.
near_miss: A daybound permanent entering with no face_change while it is day.

what_to_detect: A turn_action record of subkind day_night holding a day_night_changed event to night after a turn in which the active player cast no spells.
near_miss: A day_night turn_action record with no day_night_changed event.
record_fields: turn_action subkind day_night payload.events day_night_changed to

what_to_detect: A day_night_changed event to day when the game had neither day nor night and a daybound permanent is on the battlefield.
near_miss: A daybound permanent entering when it is already night, with no day_night_changed event.

what_to_detect: A turn_action record of subkind day_night holding a day_night_changed event to day (two or more spells cast in the previous turn) together with face_change events on nightbound permanents.
near_miss: A day_night turn_action record with no day_night_changed event.
record_fields: turn_action subkind day_night events day_night_changed, face_change

what_to_detect: A day_night_changed event to night when the game had neither day nor night and a nightbound permanent is on the battlefield with no daybound permanent.
near_miss: A state check with no day_night_changed event.
